title: Supabase-owned auth/storage platform objects absent from the local stub (tables, columns, constraints, indexes, triggers, sequences)
justification: The local stub defines only the minimal auth/storage objects the migrations reference; Production has the real GoTrue and Storage schemas. No repository migration creates or alters these objects.
evidence_and_precondition: Rows only in Production in schemas auth/storage (stage_b catalogs: tables, columns, constraints, indexes, triggers); none in public.
reproduce_in_D3: No (restored Production snapshot already contains them)
security_or_compatibility_impact: None for the application schema; platform objects are Supabase-managed

title: Stub auth/storage objects defined differently from the real ones (owner, RLS flag, column types/defaults/nullability, extra stub constraints and indexes)
justification: auth.users, auth.identities, storage.buckets and storage.objects are simplified stubs owned by postgres; real ones are owned by supabase_auth_admin / supabase_storage_admin with RLS and richer column definitions.
evidence_and_precondition: tables/columns/constraints/indexes rows in schemas auth/storage present on both sides but different, or only local (stub-defined).
security_or_compatibility_impact: None for migrations that only reference these tables; runtime behaviour is unverifiable locally

title: PostgreSQL 18 explicit NOT NULL constraints (pg_constraint contype 'n') in public
justification: PostgreSQL 18 records NOT NULL as named constraints; hosted PostgreSQL 17.6 does not. Each such constraint corresponds to a column that is NOT NULL on BOTH sides (verified per row).
evidence_and_precondition: 253 public contype 'n' rows only local; precondition: Production column not_null = true and local column not_null = true.

title: public.user_roles -> auth.users foreign key exists locally but not in Production
justification: Historical migrations create user_roles_user_id_fkey; Production does not have it (out-of-band removal; Stage B drift register). It is the original FK that pending 20261016120000 restores after deleting orphaned role rows.
evidence_and_precondition: constraints: public.user_roles.user_roles_user_id_fkey only local; Production has 0 foreign keys from user_roles.
reproduce_in_D3: Yes: D3 must start from the Production shape (no FK, orphaned role rows present)
security_or_compatibility_impact: Orphan role rows exist in Production until 20261016120000 removes them

title: public.task_status.admin_notes and crew_notes exist in Production but are created by no repository migration
justification: Out-of-band Production columns (Stage B drift register D1, parser-verified); the S3 replay shim was deliberately not implemented so the gap stays visible.
evidence_and_precondition: columns: public.task_status.admin_notes / crew_notes only in Production.
reproduce_in_D3: Yes (present in the restored snapshot; code in src/lib/database.types.ts uses admin_notes)
security_or_compatibility_impact: A rebuild from migrations alone lacks these columns

title: Policy expression deparse differs only by a ::text cast around auth.users.email
justification: Production's auth.users.email is character varying, so PostgreSQL renders a ::text cast; the stub column is text so no cast is rendered. Logic is identical.
evidence_and_precondition: 3 policies (public.orders, public.payments, storage.objects); precondition: Production auth.users.email type is varchar and the local one is text.
examples: public/orders/Customers can view own orders; public/payments/Users can view own order payments; storage/objects/Customers can view own order pictures storage

title: Function bodies differ only in whitespace (line endings)
justification: Working-tree migration files contain CRLF line endings, so locally stored function sources contain carriage returns; Production bodies use LF. Every one of the 64 pairs has an identical whitespace-normalized and comment-stripped digest, and all 68 function signatures, owners, SECURITY DEFINER flags, volatility and search_path settings are equal.
evidence_and_precondition: functions: src_md5 differs in 64 of 68; src_norm_md5 and src_nocomment_md5 equal in all 64.
examples: public/apply_balance_payment_financials/p_pi_id text, p_order_id uuid, p_balance_cents integer, p_tip_cents integer, p_pm_id text, p_customer_id text; public/approve_order_changes/p_order_id uuid, p_token text, p_customer_selected_payment_cents integer, p_customer_selected_payment_type text, p_tip_cents integer, p_confirm_status boolean; public/archive_old_orders/threshold_days integer; public/assign_role_by_email/p_email text, p_role text

title: Table/sequence grants in auth and storage that depend on platform roles and owners
justification: Production grants differ from the stub only through supabase_auth_admin, supabase_storage_admin, dashboard_user and owner differences (postgres vs platform roles). No public-schema grant differs.
evidence_and_precondition: grants_relations: all differing rows are in schemas auth/storage; public has 0 differing grants (Production and local public relation grants are identical).

title: Schema-level privileges on auth, storage and public that depend on platform roles
justification: Schema ownership and grants for supabase_admin, dashboard_user, supabase_auth_admin and supabase_storage_admin, plus Production's public schema grants to postgres and supabase_auth_admin; none comes from a repository migration.
evidence_and_precondition: grants_schemas differences (22 only Production, 10 only local).
security_or_compatibility_impact: None for application schema; platform grants unverifiable

title: Default privileges: platform-owned defaults and the postgres defaults' representation
justification: Production holds default ACLs for supabase_admin (public, extensions, graphql, graphql_public, realtime), supabase_auth_admin (auth) and postgres (storage); the stub defines none of them. For postgres in public, the local and Production ACLs grant the same privileges to anon, authenticated and service_role; Production additionally lists the owner's own entry explicitly (equal privileges), verified below.
evidence_and_precondition: default_acls: 24 only Production, 3 only local; precondition: for (postgres, public, r/S/f) the grantee/privilege sets are equal once the owner entry is ignored.
security_or_compatibility_impact: Defaults decide grants of future objects created by the named owner; none of the selected migrations runs as supabase_admin

title: Realtime platform publication, extensions, event triggers and roles that only the hosted platform provides
justification: supabase_realtime_messages_publication, pg_net, pg_stat_statements, supabase_vault, six platform event triggers and ten platform roles do not exist in plain PostgreSQL; pgcrypto is 1.3 in Production (PG17) and 1.4 locally (PG18); stub roles lack the real role attributes. supabase_realtime itself has identical membership on both sides.
evidence_and_precondition: publications/extensions/event_triggers/roles diffs. Note: roles include cli_login_postgres, the temporary role recorded earlier (not modified).

title: Storage bucket carousel-media exists in Production but is inserted by no repository migration
justification: Out-of-band Production bucket (Stage B drift register D1); 20260325231044 only UPDATEs it, which does nothing locally. S4 was deliberately not implemented.
evidence_and_precondition: storage_buckets: carousel-media only in Production; the other 7 buckets are identical.
security_or_compatibility_impact: A rebuild from migrations alone lacks the bucket although its policies exist
